limitations: Initial exploratory debug builds retain exact artifacts, helpers, matrices, raw outcomes and oracle identities, but lack exact recorded build/project source closures. Their source bytes are not inferred from run order, timestamps or the checkout. The exploration provenance ledger states the per-acquisition limits. The later runtime-build-01 has its own retained source scope; focused final artifacts here match independent complete root recorded builds.

The 363 broad observations overlap all 304 selected programs and retain 59 unselected controls. Invalid custom generic declarations, capitalized Nothing, unsupported first/isPositive/Class APIs, function call syntax, general compound List output, malformed typed let and >= token diagnostics remain complete retained observations; independent scalar, explicit-predicate, lowercase nothing and correctly spaced parser sources have their own Java-derived outcomes.

Two union alias constructors select String rather than Collection. Their Java Cannot instantiate type N versus Rust Expected a class type diagnostic mismatches remain unselected, with no exception or source substitution. Collection-selected nullable defaults and separate inferred annotation timing are selected.

Same-function and distinct-function Listing/Collection wrapper chains compare observable values and complete failures; they do not establish wrapper identity, complete same-node cache reuse or the number of successful predicate invocations.

Property-path transport observations use scalar properties authored in the source. Original unsupported direct List.length transport and earlier sequence proposals remain preserved; no adapter normalization or general compound output was introduced.

Native preliminary receiver/alias assertions and metadata compilation failures remain retained separately from stable final lifecycle evidence. These early captures lack a complete project/build closure. Actual Host retention/GC and real Node/Chromium scenarios have separate root acquisitions.

The original cycle oracle error and integer % 0 diagnostic mismatch remain in the unchanged selected development contract. Full language/product APIs, release platforms and performance/memory parity remain incomplete.

Every file under the configured original exploration roots, including cache paths, is enumerated without exclusions. Partitions are file-disjoint and bounded to 48MB raw input before metadata; each produced gzip archive must be below 80MB. Captured artifacts are never executed while sealing.

The configuration, index, active configuration/sealing/audit command outputs and later package/postseal outputs are generated metadata or independent root source/helper-history artifacts. They cannot recursively be payloads of the archives they create. Completed earlier readiness, origin and helper captures are retained here.
Tar headers use deterministic 0644 modes; ORIGINAL_PATHS records exact original paths, sizes and hashes and does not claim preservation of original executable modes.
